description:
Position: Applications Developer- Web (.NET)-Sr/Project Management
 Location: Lincoln, NE
 Duration: 2 years
 Requirements:
 * Qualified applicants will have a Bachelor's Degree in Web Development/Web Design
    or hold a Technical Degree in Computer Science (or equivalent combination of
    education and minimum 5+ years web development experience).
 * Perform daily Project Management tasks as necessary.
 * Experience leading a team of developers required.
 * Experience in software development utilizing Agile with SCRUM required.
 * Perform daily tasks of analysis, programming and testing as needed.
 * Assist with; capturing business requirements, design, .NET architecture and
    development and creation of test plans/test scripts to aid in QA/QC.
 * Develop applications in MVC pattern with MSF C#.NET, HTML, JavaScript, CSS and
    XML that interact with the Department's Information Systems.
 * Perform front-end, middle-tier and back-end development.
 * Extremely detailed oriented and able to follow Department standards.
 * Strong verbal and written communication skills.
 * Candidate must work on-site at Department of Roads, Lincoln, NE.
 * Regular and reliable attendance is required.
  
 Experience with:
 * Test Driven Development
 * Telerik Tool set
 * ADO.NET/Entity Framework based data access services using C#
  
 Preferences:
 * Experience with all aspects of project management.
 * Experience with application development in accounting/financial systems is
    preferred, but not required.
 * Experience with training Developers is a plus.
 * Experience with SSRS reports is preferred, but not required.
 * Project Management certification desired, but not required.
 



 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
